newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIAN SHARES EDGE HIGHER, UNIBANKA LEADS.
newsitem.headline: LATVIAN SHARES EDGE HIGHER, UNIBANKA LEADS.

text.p: Latvian shares saw slightly more activity by the close on Friday, led by Unibanka, with the market index rising.
There were few large price changes as turnover rose to 104,000 lats from 81,000 lats.
The bourse index added 0.50 to 384.24 while the Rietumu Bank index added 0.06 to 150.2.
Unibanka led trade again at 58,500 lats, adding two santimes to 3.31 lats.
Dealers saw little change next week in the narrow range that the market has been tracking in these quiet summer months.
"I do not think it will move much from here," said one trader.
Dealers say a pickup in trade may come in autumn and also hope that more large, state-owned companies will be privatised and come to the bourse.

They are also looking forward to the arrival of insurer Balta, which recently issued shares and is heading to the market later this year. It would be the first share on the market that was not a product of privatisation.
Other shares were quiet, with fish cannery Kaija trading 9,600 lats to be unchanged at 2.12 lats.
Riga Transport Fleet lost two santimes to 1.27 lats on turnover of 5,500 while Valmiera Glassfibre added one santime to 1.36 on 3,800 lats of trade.
